01 About me

Curious about how information moves, works and creates value.

I am an Information Management student with a growing focus on database development and information systems. I enjoy taking a real-world problem, understanding the information behind it, and turning that understanding into a structured, practical solution.

My interests sit at the intersection of technology and information: database design, data management, digital records, system development, networking and information security.
